editor.notes: S3 (D-30 section 2, engine DS1): a map's cell override sets: the Override sets panel (a tab of the map editor and the Studio's World page: create / rename / remove, persistence through a flag or variable of the scripts manifest, the chosen set previewed applied or cleared), the Override sets map tool (paint a set's cells on a layer, or take them out), the Override sets overlay and hover text in the Map tab, a validator, and the overrides command group. A built-in extension, loaded through the same plugin host as project plugins (capsule_studio.plugins).
